props.name: indicator
props.description: Replaces the caret, e.g. a plus that turns into a minus. Style it off `group-aria-expanded/accordion-trigger:`.

props.name: path
props.description: A custom body outline: SVG path data in the 100×100 body box, centred on (50, 50), replacing the type's own (and its antennae). The type still sets the face's place, the default colour and the label, so keep the outline solid round the face. Default: the type's outline.

props.name: state
props.description: What the bot is doing: `default` (idle), `working` (hopping, spinning) or `sleeping`.

props.name: color
props.description: Body colour. Defaults to the type's palette colour.

props.name: brightness
props.description: Lightness of the body colour: 1 as the palette has it, below 1 darker, above 1 lighter (0.5–1.5 is the useful range). Default `1`, or the type's own (the star's is `1.1`).

props.name: saturation
props.description: Saturation of the body colour: 1 as the palette has it, below 1 duller, above 1 more vivid, 0.5–2.5. Past 1.5, where most of the palette is already as saturated as a screen shows it, the colour is pushed along its own hue toward its most vivid shade (deepening by at most 15% where the screen cannot show it brighter), the shade side grows richer, and `plastic` and `fabric` keep more of it in the light — highlights, sheen, rim and fur tips stay coloured rather than paling toward white. Default `1.5`, or the type's own (the star's is `1.84`).

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplier on every animation's speed. Default `1`.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freeze every animation on its current frame.

props.name: seed
props.description: 0–1. Offsets the blink and glance timing so a row of avatars does not blink in unison. Defaults to a value derived from the instance id.

props.name: shading
props.description: How the body is lit: `fabric` (default), `plastic`, `crisp`, `smooth` or `flat`. `true` and `false` mean crisp and flat.

props.name: hat
props.description: A hat, sitting on the top of the head and turning with it: `beret`, `beanie`, `party` or `crown`. Default `none`.

props.name: glasses
props.description: Glasses over the eyes: `round`, `square` or `shades`. Default `none`.

props.name: headphones
props.description: Headphones over the head, a cup on either side. Default `false`.

props.name: bowTie
props.description: A bow tie under the face. Default `false`.

props.name: accessoryColor
props.description: Colour of the hat, the headphones and the bow tie. Default a soft black.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Strength of the shadow side, 0–2. Default `0.35` (`1.15` for `fabric`).

props.name: highlight
props.description: Strength of the lit side, 0–2. Default `1.3` (`1.45` for `fabric`).

props.name: depth
props.description: Thickness of the body, 0.2–2: what shows when it turns or flips. Default `0.65`.

props.name: roundness
props.description: `plastic` and `fabric`: the body's profile through its depth, 0–1. At `1` (default) it is inflated like a cushion or a plush toy — thickest in the middle and rounding off to nothing at the outline all round, so a turn shows a round side; toward `0` it becomes a slab with soft edges.

props.name: furLength
props.description: `fabric`: length of the pile, 0.3–2.5. Default `1`.

props.name: furDensity
props.description: `fabric`: how many fibres, 0.3–2. Default `1.6`.

props.name: furFuzz
props.description: `fabric`: softness of the silhouette — the haze of fine hairs standing past it, 0–1. Default `0.9`.

props.name: furClumps
props.description: `fabric`: how much the fibres gather into tufts, 0–1. Default `0.4`.

props.name: furCurl
props.description: `fabric`: how wavy the fibres are, 0 (straight) – 1. Default `0.7`.

props.name: furGravity
props.description: `fabric`: how much the pile hangs, 0–1 — combed down from a parting at the top, lying over the top edge and hanging off the sides and bottom, rather than standing out evenly all round. Default `0.9`.

props.name: light
props.description: Where the light comes from, in degrees clockwise from the top. Default `300` (`295` for `fabric`): from the upper left, like a studio key light.

props.name: rim
props.description: Width of the lit rim in `crisp` shading, strength of the Fresnel rim in `plastic`, of the back light in `fabric` — the bright rim it wraps round the top and sides, and the glow of the edge's hairs — 0–2. Default `0.5` (`0.6` for `fabric`).

props.name: backLight
props.description: `fabric`: where the back light comes from, in degrees clockwise from the top. Default: above the toy, toward the side away from `light`.

props.name: lightFront
props.description: `fabric`: how far round to the front the key light sits, in degrees — `0` grazes the toy from the side (dramatic), `85` lights it nearly from the camera (flat). Default `32`.

props.name: shine
props.description: `fabric`: strength of the highlights along single fibres where the key grazes the pile, 0–2. Default `0` (off: a soft, matte pile).

props.name: sheen
props.description: `fabric`: the smooth, satin sheen over the body's edge — the key's sheen and the back light's band as even gradients, a material shine rather than the fur's own — 0 (matte, only the fibres shine) – 2. Default `0`.

props.name: backSoftness
props.description: `fabric`: how soft the back light is, 0–1 — `0` a small source caught on single fibres as crisp bright hairs, `1` a large one, an even glow reaching further in from the edge and fading out gently. Default `1`.

props.name: spread
props.description: Reach of the soft shading in `smooth`, width of the highlight in `plastic`, how far the light wraps round in `fabric`, 0.4–2.5. Default `1.55` (`1.6` for `fabric`).

props.name: pose
props.type: { yaw?: number; pitch?: number; roll?: number }
props.description: Holds the body at this orientation, in radians — `yaw` turns it to the viewer's right, `pitch` tips it to look up, `roll` tilts it — in the state's rest pose, overriding the animation's turns, hops and glances (and pointer play) while it is set. For turning an avatar round by hand, as a 3D viewer does; usually with `paused`.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Pointer play: the eyes and head follow a pointer that comes near, and a click makes the avatar hop and turn right round. Default `true`.

props.name: theme
props.description: The surface the avatar sits on, for touches that have to read against it. `auto` (default) reads an ancestor `data-theme` attribute or `dark` / `light` class, then `prefers-color-scheme`.

props.name: turn
props.description: How far the head turns from side to side while idle, 0–2: `1` as the library has it, `0` keeps it facing forward. Default `1`.

props.name: whirl
props.description: The whirl round a spin: its strength, 0–2. Off by default (`0`); `1` turns it on.

props.name: whirlSize
props.description: Size of the whirl's ring, 0.6–1.6. Default `1`.

props.name: whirlWidth
props.description: Thickness of the whirl's trail, 0.4–2. Default `1`.

props.name: whirlLength
props.description: Length of the trail round the ring, 0.4–1.6. Default `1`.

props.name: whirlTilt
props.description: How flat the ring is seen, 0.5–1.8 (higher is more open). Default `1`.

props.name: jumpHeight
props.description: The jump (an idle flip, a click): how high, in body units — the body is 100 tall. Default `26`.

props.name: jumpTime
props.description: Seconds the jump spends in the air. Default `0.68`.

props.name: jumpStretch
props.description: How much the body stretches in the air, 0–2. Default `1`.

props.name: jumpSquash
props.description: How much the body squashes on the ground, before take-off and on landing, 0–2. Default `1.15`.

props.name: jumpSquashTime
props.description: Seconds the landing squash takes, from contact to recovered. Default `0.37`.

props.name: jumpSquashEase
props.description: How the landing squash plays out: `sharp` (all at once, then eases off), `pulse` (a quick press that recovers without a wobble, the default), `soft` (eases in and out), `bouncy` (overshoots into a stretch and settles).

props.name: jumpGroundTime
props.description: Seconds a jump holds its deepest squash on the ground before recovering. Default `0.11`.

props.name: jumpGroundEase
props.description: How the weight settles through that hold, in the same shapes as `jumpSquashEase`: the body presses a little deeper and comes back to the held depth, `sharp` at once, `pulse` quickly, `soft` in the middle, `bouncy` with a wobble. Default `pulse`.

props.name: jumpRiseTime
props.description: Seconds the body takes to rise from its deepest squash back to its own shape. Default `0.33`.

props.name: jumpRiseEase
props.description: How it rises: `sharp` lets go at once and eases in to rest, `pulse` leaves quickly with a long settle, `soft` eases out of the squash and into rest, `bouncy` passes rest into a slight stretch and settles back. Default `pulse`.

props.name: jumpClickSquashTime
props.description: Seconds a click's jump takes for its landing squash (an idle jump's uses `jumpSquashTime`). Default `0.24`.

props.name: jumpSpin
props.description: Whole turns made in the air, 0–2. Default `1`.

props.name: jumpLean
props.description: Degrees of lean into a jump. Default `6`.

props.name: jumpEvery
props.description: Seconds between idle jumps, give or take 40 %; 0 for none. Default `8`.

props.name: jumpLand
props.description: When the landing squash begins: seconds before touch-down (negative, bracing for the ground) or after it. Default `0`, the moment of contact.

props.name: name
props.description: Display name, for the default aria-label.

props.name: role
props.description: What the agent does, read out with the name.

props.name: shape
props.description: Body shape. Default `clover`.

props.name: face
props.description: Face kind. Default `eyes`.

props.name: ink
props.description: Face ink. Default: dark on a light body, light on a dark one.

props.name: size
props.description: Rendered size in px. Omit to fill 75% of the slot.

props.name: aria-hidden
props.description: Hide the canvas from assistive tech when a parent already names the agent.

props.name: agents
props.description: The cast to lay out.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: Selected agent id, when the cast is a picker.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the agent that was picked.

props.name: showRole
props.description: Hide the role line under each name.

props.name: avatarProps
props.description: Extra props forwarded to every `<AgentAvatar>`.

props.name: minColumn
props.description: Minimum card width, any CSS length. Controls the column count.

props.name: error
props.description: A line under the input, for a send that failed. Cleared by passing null.

props.name: accent
props.description: Colour of the focus ring. Falls back to `--ring`.

props.name: band
props.description: A hairline and a quiet surface out to both edges and the bottom corners. Last child only.

props.name: as
props.description: Tag to render. Default `div`.

props.name: onMount
props.description: Play on mount instead of waiting for the group to scroll into view.

props.name: preset
props.description: Preset geometry. Default `fade`.

props.name: delay
props.description: Wait before the first item starts, in ms.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Gap between consecutive items, in ms. Defaults to `--duration-stagger`.

props.name: duration
props.description: One item's run time, in ms. Defaults to `--duration-slow`.

props.name: once
props.description: Play once and stay revealed, instead of replaying on every re-entry.

props.name: amount
props.description: Fraction of the element that must be visible before it plays.

props.name: margin
props.description: `rootMargin` for the observer, e.g. `"0px 0px -15% 0px"`.

props.name: edgeFade
props.description: Softens the left and right ends of the filled area instead of cutting them off at the plot edge.

props.name: reference
props.description: A target drawn across the plot, like the deal a cost runs up to.

props.name: resting
props.description: The headline while no point is hovered, like a period total. Defaults to the last point.

props.name: smoothing
props.description: Smooths the drawn line by the window shown; the resting figure stays the caller's total.

props.name: tone
props.description: The severity scale. Draws an outlined chip in the tone's colours and ignores `variant`.

props.name: yKey
props.description: The bar's value. Required unless `series` is set.

props.name: series
props.description: Stacks these keys into one bar per row; the bar's value is their sum.

props.name: colorOf
props.description: A fill per bar, for bands whose meaning changes along the axis.

props.name: height
props.description: Body height in px, or "fill" to grow to the parent's height (parent must be a flex column that gives the chart a determinate height). Default 240.

props.name: leftPadding
props.description: Left padding for horizontal charts (label space). Default 80.

props.name: formatTick
props.description: Axis tick label. Return "" to skip a tick. Defaults to formatX.

props.name: label
props.description: Screen-reader summary; also renders an sr-only data table when set.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: Column header for the x values in the sr-only table.

props.name: yLabel
props.description: Column header for the y values in the sr-only table, and the tooltip's label.

props.name: details
props.description: Extra tooltip rows under the value, for a second measure of the same row.

props.name: showFigure
props.description: Show the value/label figure above the chart.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one lap. Default 1.96s, or 2.4s at size="line".

props.name: onNote
props.description: The note button drops a note card, so the host owns what it does. Omit it to hide the button.

props.name: extra
props.description: Sits last on the rail, for what only the host knows, like the card palette.

props.name: layout
props.description: Stacked rows vs inline wrap.

props.name: showProgress
props.description: Render a progress bar under each row (needs maxValue).

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the value beside each label.

props.name: showPercentage
props.description: Append a percentage (needs maxValue).

props.name: hoveredIndex
props.description: Hovered index, bindable for chart hover-sync.

props.name: size
props.description: Dot diameter in px.

props.name: code
props.description: Plain text to render. Split into lines when `lineNumbers` is set.

props.name: code
props.description: The line as plain text, or as highlighted tokens. When it is set, `children` is ignored.

props.name: wrapperClass
props.description: Classes for the row that holds the glyph, the field and `trailing`.

props.name: size
props.description: `lg` is the standalone search header; `default` is a combobox popover.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Right-aligned affordances: a dismiss hint, a close button, a scope chip.

props.name: value
props.description: What lands on the clipboard. A function runs on the click, so a long list doesn't build every prompt up front. It may return a promise.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the thing being copied, for a screen reader and the tooltip.

props.name: copiedLabel
props.description: Announced when the write lands; see `announce`.

props.name: text
props.description: The chip's visible text. Its presence is what makes this a chip.

props.name: agent
props.description: Marks the payload as an instruction for an AI rather than a raw string.

props.name: size
props.description: `sm` matches `OpenIn`, for the icon row inside a calendar chip. `md` is the 28px icon `Button`, for a toolbar that sits beside other icon buttons.

props.name: variant
props.description: Ghost unless it sits beside an outline button; `inline` is for the chip, taking the surrounding text's font and colour.

props.name: announce
props.description: `region` announces `copiedLabel` in a live region; `name` swaps the button's name to it (write it in full), for a page rendering hundreds of these.

props.name: onCopied
props.description: Runs after a write that landed, for a toast the call site owns.

props.name: note
props.description: One line on the right: a window, a provenance, a count. Never a sentence.

props.name: href
props.description: The page that owns this area, when one page does.

props.name: openLabel
props.description: The link's wording. Translated at the call site.

props.name: href
props.description: Give this and the strip is links, so the choice survives reload, back and a shared link. Omit it and the strip is a `<SegmentedFilter>` the caller owns.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Filter mode only. Ignored when `href` is set.

props.name: children
props.description: `<StatTile>` children. Four to a row on a desk, two on a phone.

props.name: columns
props.description: Cards per row at the widest breakpoint, four unless the set is smaller. Five and six are only for a fixed scorecard. The headline stays one row.

props.name: value
props.description: Already formatted. The tile never guesses a currency or a locale.

props.name: deltaPct
props.description: Percent change against the previous period. `null` means nothing to compare yet and draws a dash. Omit it when the figure has no period at all.

props.name: lead
props.description: The one figure the screen was opened to read. Set it on exactly one tile.

props.name: hint
props.description: A quiet line under the value: what it was measured over, or why it is a dash.

props.name: share
props.description: 0 to 1, drawn as a track under the value: share of a total or progress to a target. Omit it for a cash balance.

props.name: shareLabel
props.description: What `share` is measured against, e.g. "of revenue". Only with `share`.

props.name: color
props.description: Track colour. The first series token unless a tile means something else.

props.name: series
props.description: A shape behind the figure, oldest first, bled along the card's bottom. The treatment every tile gives a number with a history. Omit when there is none.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading mark before the label.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the tile a link, like a balance that opens the bank. It lives here so a linked figure isn't drawn as a second, different card style.

props.name: hrefLabel
props.description: What the link opens, shown on hover. Only with `href`.

props.name: target
props.description: `_blank` for a figure that leaves the app (a bank, a provider console), `_self` for one that is another page of this app. Only with `href`.

props.name: badge
props.description: A chip at the end of the label row: the limit the figure is judged against, the state it is in. Wins over `hrefLabel`, which is only a hover hint.

props.name: negative
props.description: A loss or an overrun: the figure turns the destructive colour.

props.name: children
props.description: `<DataPanel>` children, or tiles standing beside one.

props.name: columns
props.description: Panels per row: two charts, three breakdowns, or `main`, where the first child takes two thirds and the rates beside it one third.

props.name: label
props.description: What this section of the dashboard is. Drawn as the app's one panel label.

props.name: hint
props.description: A row count, total or freshness stamp. It's a prop, not an action, because hand-placed hints ended up at three type sizes on one screen.

props.name: actions
props.description: Controls that act on this panel. Pinned right, after the hint.

props.name: sublabel
props.description: A line under the label, for the scope a number was measured over.

props.name: pad
props.description: Off for a body that supplies its own padding: a table, a full-bleed list.

props.name: scroll
props.description: The body scrolls sideways rather than squeezing. For a wide table, which is every table on a dashboard once the window is narrower than its columns.

props.name: active
props.description: True when the table is currently ranked by this column.

props.name: descending
props.description: Which way the active column runs. Ignored while inactive.

props.name: onSort
props.description: Called on click and on Enter/Space. Toggling direction is the caller's.

props.name: numeric
props.description: Numbers right-align to their digits, so their caret leads the label.

props.name: title
props.description: The long form of an abbreviated head, as the browser tooltip.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Drawn where a value or rating is null.

props.name: leadWidth
props.description: A Tailwind width class. Omit and the lead takes whatever the figures leave.

props.name: minWidth
props.description: A Tailwind min-width class, past which the panel scrolls sideways.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Omit for every row on one page.

props.name: rowHref
props.description: The row opens a page. The lead becomes the link.

props.name: onRowClick
props.description: The row opens in place: a panel, a detail view. The lead becomes the button.

props.name: loading
props.description: Placeholder rows while the data is on its way.

props.name: empty
props.description: Drawn in place of the body when there are no rows.

props.name: hint
props.description: What the letter hides: the score and what it was charged for.

props.name: actions
props.description: One or two buttons. Omit where there is nothing the reader can do.

props.name: rows
props.description: Number of skeleton rows to render

props.name: columns
props.description: Column definitions control skeleton widths and alignment

props.name: columnCount
props.description: Simple mode: just specify column count

props.name: buildHref
props.description: If provided, renders <a> tags instead of buttons (for server-side pagination)

props.name: skeleton
props.description: Skeleton snippet rendered while loading more

props.name: onCopied
props.description: Called after a successful clipboard copy so consumers can show their own toast

props.name: overlayClass
props.description: Classes for the backdrop this dialog mounts, which is its sibling in the portal and so cannot be reached from the content's own class.

props.name: band
props.description: Draw the footer as a band: a hairline on top and a quiet surface out to both edges and the bottom corners. It cancels the content's `--dialog-pad` with a negative margin, so it only works as the content's last child. A bare `data-band` attribute does the same, for callers on a release that predates this prop.

props.name: summary
props.description: One line under the title. Optional: a page with nothing to add leaves it out.

props.name: section
props.description: Where the page lives, as a reader would say it: "Marketing / Reports".

props.name: updated
props.description: Already worded and localised: "Updated 30 Jul 2026".

props.name: actions
props.description: Room at the right of the title for a page's own controls.

props.name: headings
props.description: The document's h2s, which the contents rail walks. Under two, there's no rail.

props.name: contentsLabel
props.description: The rail's name: "On this page".

props.name: locate
props.description: Supplied by a document that lives in a frame; the default reads the DOM by id.

props.name: resetKey
props.description: Changes when the page is swapped without navigation, so the pane returns to the top.

props.name: measure
props.description: The reading column's width. `wide` is for a document that brings tables and boards.

props.name: scroller
props.description: The scroll box, for a document that has to place things inside it.

props.name: active
props.description: The id the reader is in.

props.name: label
props.description: What the rail is called: "On this page". Passed in so the library holds no copy.

props.name: variant
props.description: `rail` sits beside the document, `bar` replaces it on a narrow pane, and `ticks` marks each heading in the gutter with a card of headings on hover or focus.

props.name: centerLabel
props.description: Center label shown when nothing is hovered

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Format the center value

props.name: for
props.description: Id of the control the label binds to. Also picks the control that gets the message link.

props.name: labelVariant
props.description: "default" is text-sm foreground; "muted" is a text-xs micro-label.

props.name: value
props.description: Arc fill, 0-100 (how many notches light up).

props.name: variant
props.description: "gauge" = notched arc, "ring" = continuous swept arc.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the center value/label. Off when the number sits beside the gauge.

props.name: color
props.description: Active arc color (CSS color or var). Alias for `activeFill`.

props.name: gradient
props.description: Single-hue gradient along the active arc. Alias for `useGradient`.

props.name: label
props.description: Center label under the value. Alias for `defaultLabel`.

props.name: centerValue
props.description: Center statistic. Defaults to `value`. Formatted via `formatOptions`.

props.name: totalNotches
props.description: Notch count around the arc.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Gap between notches as a percentage of the arc.

props.name: notchLengthPercent
props.description: Radial depth of the notch band as a percentage of the default.

props.name: notchCornerRadius
props.description: Corner fillet in viewBox units (0 = sharp). Defaults to a soft pill.

props.name: uniformWidth
props.description: Rectangular notches instead of angular/tapered.

props.name: startAngle
props.description: Arc start in degrees (default 135, sweeping to 405 = 270deg with a bottom gap).

props.name: useGradient
props.description: Single-hue gradient along the active arc instead of a flat fill.

props.name: activeGradient
props.description: Hex stops for the active gradient. Defaults to a tonal ramp of `activeFill`.

props.name: activeFill
props.description: Active notch color (CSS color or var).

props.name: inactiveFill
props.description: Track notch color. Defaults to `activeFill`.

props.name: defaultLabel
props.description: Center label under the value.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: Intl formatting for the center value.

props.name: size
props.description: Fixed square size in px. Omit to fill the parent (responsive).

props.name: minWidth
props.description: Minimum width when responsive.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible description, e.g. "ARR run rate".

props.name: variant
props.description: Uses the button recipe so call sites stop drawing their own. `variant: null` opts out, for a caller that really is a menu row.

props.name: icon
props.description: Square, for a glyph with no label. Mirrors `Button`.

props.name: before
props.description: Image shown on the left of the handle.

props.name: after
props.description: Image shown on the right of the handle.

props.name: position
props.description: Handle position, 0-100. Bind it to read it or to move the handle from outside.

props.name: hover
props.description: Track the pointer without a press. The handle returns to where it began.

props.name: hint
props.description: Positions the handle visits once on mount, then it returns to where it began. It stops for good at the first touch. Tells a visitor the frame moves.

props.name: eager
props.description: Load both images now, ahead of the rest of the page. For a frame above the fold.

props.name: label
props.description: Label announced for the slider.

props.name: beforeBadge
props.description: A label drawn over the left side, such as "Before".

props.name: afterBadge
props.description: A label drawn over the right side, such as "After".

props.name: badgeEdge
props.description: Which edge the badges sit on.

props.name: src
props.description: Image(s) to reveal. An array picks one at random per cycle, never the previous one.

props.name: autoReveal
props.description: Run the auto loop: shimmer -> reveal -> hold -> hide -> repeat.

props.name: revealDelayRange
props.description: Seconds of shimmer between reveals when auto-revealing.

props.name: revealHoldMs
props.description: Milliseconds the image stays fully visible before it hides.

props.name: revealDurationMs
props.description: Milliseconds of the dissolve-in reveal animation.

props.name: revealFadeOutMs
props.description: Milliseconds of the cross-fade back to the shimmer.

props.name: cell
props.description: Mosaic cell size in CSS pixels.

props.name: borderRadius
props.description: Corner radius in CSS pixels. Auto-detected from the wrapper when omitted.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freeze the shimmer and the scheduler.

props.name: strength

props.name: options
props.description: The labels people pick from. Picking one stores its exact spelling and case.

props.name: allowCreate
props.description: Whether a label that isn't an option may be made, through the "Create" row only. Text close to an option never becomes a label unless that row is chosen.

props.name: max
props.description: Most tags the list holds. Past it the input goes away.

props.name: free
props.description: Tags typed freely, with no options and no menu: Enter, comma, space or Tab adds what's typed, a pasted list adds every part, and leaving the field keeps what was typed.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the field.

props.name: getStart
props.description: ISO date, inclusive. Null or empty means undated: with an end date alone the task starts the same day, and with neither it has no bar of its own.

props.name: getEnd
props.description: ISO date, inclusive. See `getStart`.

props.name: getParent
props.description: The parent task's id; a parent with no dates of its own draws the span of the children nested under it.

props.name: isMilestone
props.description: Draws a flag at the end date instead of a bar. Milestones are not draggable.

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Parent ids that start folded.

props.name: noDatesLabel
props.description: Shown in place of a bar for an undated task.

props.name: getHue
props.description: Any CSS color for the bar. Falls back to the group hue, then the primary color.

props.name: getProgress
props.description: 0 to 1. Fills the bar from the left.

props.name: getDependsOn
props.description: Ids this task waits on. Draws an arrow from each one's end to this one's start.

props.name: groups
props.description: Group rows under a header, in the order given. Same shape as board columns.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called after a bar is dragged, resized or nudged. Leave it out for a read-only chart.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called on a click or Enter that did not move the bar.

props.name: renderLabel
props.description: The left column for a row. Defaults to the title.

props.name: from
props.description: First and last day shown. Default: the tasks' span, padded, starting on a Monday.

props.name: today
props.description: The day the today line marks. Defaults to the viewer's today.

props.name: labelWidth
props.description: Width of the task column in px. It never takes more than 40% of a narrow screen.

props.name: flat
props.description: Drops the card chrome (border, radius, fill) so the chart sits flat on the page.

props.name: groups
props.description: The same shape as board columns, so one config feeds both views.

props.name: getGroup
props.description: The group id a row belongs to.

props.name: getParent
props.description: Nests a group under another by its id, e.g. a project under its client, so it folds with its parent. Return nothing for a top-level group.

props.name: onMove
props.description: Called on drop with what to persist. Same contract as the board.

props.name: head
props.description: Optional sticky header row above every group, e.g. column labels.

props.name: actions
props.description: Controls at the end of a group header, shown on hover, focus or a coarse pointer.

props.name: groupFooter
props.description: Rendered under a group's rows, e.g. an add-task row. Folds with the group.

props.name: manualTiebreak
props.description: Breaks a tie in manual order: two rows with the same key, or both without one.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Rows drag and take Alt plus Up or Down. Turn it off for a list that only groups, where rows hold their own links and buttons.

props.name: getLabel
props.description: The screen-reader name of a row. Defaults to a hint about the keyboard move.

props.name: onCollapsedChange
props.description: Fires when a group is folded or unfolded, with every folded id.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Groups can be folded from their header. Defaults to true.

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Group ids that start folded.

props.name: onAdd
props.description: Shows a plus in each default group head that adds a row to that group.

props.name: addLabel
props.description: The plus button's accessible name, followed by the group label.

props.name: flat
props.description: Drops the card chrome (border, radius, fill) so the list sits flat on the page. Group dividers stay.

props.name: text
props.description: The line to reveal. Plain text only; `\n` splits lines when `per="line"`.

props.name: per
props.description: What one staggered step is. Default `word`.

props.name: as
props.description: Tag to render. Default `p`.

props.name: onMount
props.description: Play on mount instead of waiting for the text to scroll into view.

props.name: preset
props.description: Preset geometry. Default `fade`.

props.name: delay
props.description: Wait before the first item starts, in ms.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Gap between consecutive items, in ms. Defaults to `--duration-stagger`.

props.name: duration
props.description: One item's run time, in ms. Defaults to `--duration-slow`.

props.name: once
props.description: Play once and stay revealed, instead of replaying on every re-entry.

props.name: amount
props.description: Fraction of the element that must be visible before it plays.

props.name: margin
props.description: `rootMargin` for the observer, e.g. `"0px 0px -15% 0px"`.

props.name: isDark
props.description: Used when `mode` is absent.

props.name: mode
props.description: The icon follows the mode: Sun, Moon or Monitor. The slide variant has no third state, so `system` reads as light.

props.name: onToggle
props.description: Fires after the wipe has started. The caller flips the theme here.

props.name: variant
props.description: `slide` is a pill track with a thumb that moves between a sun and a moon.

props.name: inverted
props.description: Alias for `variant="inverted"`.

props.name: size
props.description: `sm` is 32px tall, `default` is 40px, in every variant.

props.name: label
props.description: Overrides the aria-label and the screen-reader text.

props.name: skipTransition
props.description: Apply the change without the circular wipe.

props.name: events
props.description: Status moves, assignments and the like, one quiet line each between the comments.

props.name: loading
props.description: Rows still on their way. Draws skeleton rows in place of the thread.

props.name: avatar
props.description: Replaces the default avatar for a person or an agent, drawn in a 24px slot.

props.name: attachments
props.description: Content under a comment's body, such as files.

props.name: anchorChip
props.description: Replaces the default "Pinned" chip on a comment that has an anchor.

props.name: when
props.description: How a timestamp reads. Defaults to a short date.

props.name: whenEvent
props.description: How an event's time reads. Defaults to a short date.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale the default times read in.

props.name: onPost
props.description: Returns false to keep the draft. Without it no composer shows.

props.name: onResolve
props.description: Without it a root has no resolve button.

props.name: onAnchor
props.description: A click on a pinned comment's chip, to move a canvas to its node.

props.name: canEdit
props.description: Whose comments carry the edit and delete buttons. A rich comment can't be edited here.

props.name: heading
props.description: False hides the visible title, for a thread already named by its tab. Screen readers still get it.

props.name: footer
props.description: Drawn above the composer, such as a question waiting on an answer.

props.name: selected
props.description: The key of the open thread. Without a match the first thread opens.

props.name: unreadFirst
props.description: Threads with unread entries come first.

props.name: typeLabels
props.description: Display names for subject types, such as `{ task: "Tasks" }`. A missing type shows as written.

props.name: avatar
props.description: Replaces the default avatar for a person or an agent, drawn in a 24px slot.

props.name: status
props.description: A badge for the subject's status, drawn by the host with its own status map.

props.name: renderProposal
props.description: Replaces a pinned proposal's summary lines.

props.name: attachments
props.description: Content under an entry's text, such as links to what it mentions.

props.name: threadLabels
props.description: The words of the thread under the pinned card, such as its "Activity" heading.

props.name: when
props.description: How a timestamp reads. Defaults to a relative time.

props.name: onRead
props.description: `read` is true when the thread had unread entries, so the host marks them all read.

props.name: onReadAll
props.description: Alt+U: mark every thread read.

props.name: showSnoozed
props.description: The host is passing snoozed threads too, each with `subject.snoozedUntil`.

props.name: onShowSnoozed
props.description: Adds "Show snoozed" to the filter. The host passes the snoozed entries or stops.

props.name: onUnsnooze
props.description: `h` on a snoozed thread brings it back now.

props.name: onUnfollow
props.description: Shift+S on a thread whose `subject.followed` is set.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Backspace: take the thread out of the inbox. The host stops passing its entries, and new activity can bring it back. A thread holding a pending proposal can't be cleared.

props.name: onClearRead
props.description: Shift+Backspace: clear every thread with nothing unread and no pending proposal.

props.name: softMax
props.description: Clamp Y-axis to 95th percentile so outlier spikes don't flatten normal data

props.name: yMin
props.description: Y-axis floor. Raise above 0 to frame variation around a baseline.

props.name: edgeFade
props.description: Softens the left and right ends of the filled area instead of cutting them off at the plot edge.

props.name: search
props.description: The search text. Leave it out for no search.

props.name: searchLabel
props.description: The label of the narrow search button. Translate at the call site.

props.name: tabs
props.description: A strip of tabs, such as All, Open and Done.

props.name: views
props.description: How the page shows its records: a list, a board, a grid. Each one needs an icon.

props.name: filters
props.description: Controls that stay on the row at every width, such as filter chips. They scroll sideways before they wrap.

props.name: actions
props.description: The primary action and its neighbours, pinned to the right edge.

props.name: key
props.description: The key a row is tracked by.

props.name: kind
props.description: `plans` stacks cards that need a decision. `tasks` is one divided list of what was decided.

props.name: row
props.description: One row: a `TriagePlan` for `plans`, a `TriageTask` for `tasks`.

props.name: empty
props.description: What the person reads when nothing is waiting.

props.name: icon
props.description: The glyph above the empty text.

props.name: sender
props.description: Who sent the email.

props.name: snippet
props.description: The first lines of the body.

props.name: received
props.description: When it arrived, as text the host already formatted.

props.name: receivedAt
props.description: The ISO time behind `received`, for the `time` element.

props.name: plan
props.description: What the plan will do, as one sentence. Without it the card only offers to dismiss.

props.name: reason
props.description: Why the model wasn't sure.

props.name: error
props.description: A failed attempt, shown on the card.

props.name: onApprove
props.description: Run the plan. The buttons stay disabled until it settles.

props.name: onPick
props.description: Run a task the person typed instead of the plan.

props.name: outcome
props.description: What happened to the email.

props.name: task
props.description: The task it became.

props.name: when
props.description: When it settled, as text the host already formatted.

props.name: detail
props.description: Why it failed.

props.name: onUndo
props.description: Takes the change back. The button shows only when this is passed.

props.name: hue
props.description: Any CSS colour. Tints the well only while something is held over it.

props.name: active
props.description: Something is held over the well.

props.name: hue
props.description: The status colour of the dot. Leave out for no dot.

props.name: onAdd
props.description: Shows a plus at the end that adds an item to this group.

props.name: children
props.description: Extra controls before the plus.

props.name: meta
props.description: The bottom row: dates, subtasks, time, avatars.

props.name: icon
props.description: A Phosphor icon before the label.

props.name: layout
props.description: `responsive`: the label hides in a narrow container (a chip row) and shows as a column from `@3xl` up. `row`: always icon, label, value.
